label: Armour classes
description: How tough the unit is, as a band. Combined with one or two armour models on the card.

terms.label: Unarmoured
terms.description: Flesh and cloth: soldiers and animals.

terms.label: Light
terms.description: Buggies, drones, helicopters and armoured infantry. Soldiers are unarmoured unless their game gives them a tougher category.

terms.label: Medium
terms.description: IFVs, light tanks, power suits, light walkers.

terms.label: Heavy
terms.description: Main battle tanks and assault mechs.

terms.label: Super-heavy
terms.description: Super-heavy tanks, giant mechs and airships.
